intro.text: A way of saving someone who is choking, by heaving them upward again and again until whatever is stuck flies out.

description.text: December was taught it by a travelling doctor and rescued a choking Rema with it. When she tells Lord Geoffrim, he knows it by the name Edak maneuver.
Flint learned it once he had watched a man nearly die on a tomato. Talking it over with December one evening, he called it the Gorge maneuver to test whether she truly knew it.
